description: Exact paired input to statistics_protocol.analyze(sessions, confirmation, claim, seed=274019, resamples=20000) for registration v3.1. Pairs are per-process means (gating) and medians (secondary) of the 200 retained public calls in each process file. Each pair is {candidate_ms, reference_ms, valid}. Inferential sessions = s1..s3; confirmation = s4.
